issues.title: Victory/defeat conditions absent
issues.description: No canonical win/lose condition exists in the codebase. The game runs indefinitely with no termination state.
issues.rootCause: Not yet designed. Current Gate focuses on core loop (buy→build→compete→react), not endgame.
issues.proposedSolution: Define victory condition in DECISIONS.md before implementation. Candidate: equity threshold at month 24, or bankruptcy (cash < 0 for 3 consecutive months).

issues.title: Public land selection shows rival building instead of municipal context
issues.description: Clicking on a public parcel with a rival building but no facility/space showed 'Edificio rival' inspector instead of 'suelo municipal'. The selection logic fell through to building lookup on public land.
issues.rootCause: Two defects in apps/web/src/ui/selection.ts: (1) selectionTargetForCell lacked explicit return after public land facility/space checks, causing fallthrough to building lookup. (2) resolveSemanticSelection didn't check parcel.disposition === 'public' for building/construction targets from entity clicks.
issues.proposedSolution: Added explicit returns for public land cases in both functions. Regression tests cover both paths.

issues.title: Onboarding banner stuck on 'first_parcel' after purchase
issues.description: Onboarding banner shows 'Compra tu primera parcela' even after the player has purchased a parcel and completed a building. The step should advance to 'resources' or later.
issues.rootCause: Hypothesis: deriveOnboardingStep uses useMemo(() => deriveOnboardingStep(economy), [economy]). The economy prop may not reflect current state, or the React component isn't re-rendering when ownedParcels changes. Needs devtools investigation.
issues.proposedSolution: Verify economy object identity and ownership data. Check if ownedParcels filter (ownerOrganizationId === PLAYER) matches actual parcel data. Add useEffect logging to trace reactivity.

issues.title: No compatible tenants available after building completion
issues.description: After completing a residential building, the UI shows 'No hay inquilinos compatibles disponibles'. This is expected alpha behavior: housing market runs monthly, tenants need searchMonths >= 1 before placement.
issues.rootCause: runHousingMarket executes at tick % GAME_MONTH_TICKS === 0. admitArrivals creates tenants with searchMonths: 0. placeSearchers requires searchMonths >= 1. Player must wait one full monthly settlement cycle.
issues.proposedSolution: Not a bug. Document as alpha limitation. Consider showing 'Los inquilinos llegarán el próximo mes' instead of error message.
